TODDLER 1

12–18 months: first words grow up.

The Toddler 1 class. Around this age toddlers point at everything, understand far more than they can say and love naming the things they see every day, so this lesson pairs simple foods and home objects with clear, natural words.

Age 12–18 MonthsClass Toddler 1Subjects Talk, thinking, recognition
Lesson 7Talk & Think

First Words: Food & Home

Everyday foods and home things — apple, cup, spoon, bed — name them, pause, and let the first words grow. Three to five playful minutes.
